text: {"edits": [], "notes": "No edits proposed. The failing call is `return json.loads(page_of(items, page).json())` at line 27 of app/service.py. It is a deprecated Pydantic v1 API (`.json()` -> `.model_dump_json()`), and the test failure confirms it. However, no listed finding covers line 27, and the previous attempt to change it was rejected as out of scope. Under the scope rules I can't address it without a finding that names it, and I won't invent a finding id. The fix is a one-line change that needs a finding for app/service.py line 27, deprecated-method, `.json()` -> `.model_dump_json()`. The intended replacement is `return json.loads(page_of(items, page).model_dump_json())`. Once that finding exists, the edit can be proposed against the current content. The existing migrations (`Item.model_validate(r, from_attributes=True)` at line 13 and `item.model_copy(...)` in restock) are correct and left unchanged. `_cache.copy().dict()` in cache_snapshot is not flagged: `_cache` is an app.cache LRU, not a Pydantic model, so it is left alone. The `Page[Item](...)` construction in page_of is valid in v2 and needs no change."}
